title: Uncomfortable shoes
description: A bilingual lesson in which a lady asks a shop assistant for a pair of fashionable black shoes her sister bought in the U.S. last month. The assistant says they were in fashion last year and the year before last but are not in fashion this year, and that the current shoes are very uncomfortable but women always wear uncomfortable shoes. Includes a fill-in dialogue, a vocabulary exercise on un- adjectives, and grammar on past-tense verb forms, completing sentences with the past tense, and 'Did ... have ...?' dialogue rewrites. 课文讲述一位女士向售货员询问她姐姐上个月在美国买到的一双时髦的黑色鞋子。售货员说这种鞋去年和前年流行，今年已不流行了，现在流行的鞋很舒适但女人们总是穿不舒适的鞋。配合教材填空对话、un- 形容词反义词练习，以及动词过去式、过去时填空、"Did ... have ...?" 对话改写的语法练习。
answer_note: Lesson listening question answer is a suggested model answer based on the dialogue. Practice A (dialogue fill-in) answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 75 key (img/key-075-080.jpg). Practice B (un- adjectives) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-6 are taken from the supplied Lesson 75 key (img/key-075-080.jpg). Grammar I (past tense forms) answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 75 grammar key (PDF viewer page 506). Grammar II (fill in the past tense) answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 75 grammar key (PDF viewer page 506). Grammar III (rewrite the dialogue) the printed example (Did it have any doors? / Yes. It had one door.) is not editable; the remaining 10 items are taken from the supplied Lesson 75 grammar key (PDF viewer page 506). Grammar IV (finish the sentences) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-10 are taken from the supplied Lesson 75 grammar key (PDF viewer page 506). No external sources were used.

lesson.text:
Listen then answer this question.
What's wrong with the fashionable shoes?
听录音，然后回答问题。这些时髦的鞋有什么毛病？
lesson.translation: Listen then answer this question. What's wrong with the fashionable shoes?

lines.speaker: LADY
lines.text: Do you have any shoes like these?
lines.translation: 女士：像这样的鞋子你们有吗？

lines.speaker: SHOP ASSISTANT
lines.text:
I'm sorry.
We don't have any.
lines.translation: 售货员：对不起，我们没有。

lines.speaker: LADY
lines.text: But my sister bought this pair last month.
lines.translation: 女士：但是，我姐姐上个月买到了这样的一双。

lines.speaker: SHOP ASSISTANT
lines.translation: 售货员：她是在这儿买的吗？

lines.speaker: LADY
lines.text: No, she bought them in the U.S.
lines.translation: 女士：不。她是在美国买的。

lines.speaker: SHOP ASSISTANT
lines.text:
We had some shoes like those a month ago,
but we don't have any now.
lines.translation: 售货员：一个月前我们有这样的鞋，但是现在没有了。

lines.speaker: LADY
lines.text: Can you get a pair for me, please?
lines.translation: 女士：您能为我找一双吗？

lines.speaker: SHOP ASSISTANT
lines.text:
I'm afraid that I can't.
They were in fashion last year
and the year before last.
But they're not in fashion this year.
lines.translation: 售货员：恐怕不行。这鞋在去年和前年时兴，而今年已不流行了。

lines.speaker: SHOP ASSISTANT
lines.text: These shoes are in fashion now.
lines.translation: 售货员：现在流行的是这种鞋子。

lines.speaker: LADY
lines.translation: 女士：这种鞋子看上去很不舒服。

lines.speaker: SHOP ASSISTANT
lines.text:
They are very uncomfortable.
But women always wear uncomfortable shoes!
lines.translation: 售货员：的确很不舒服。可是女人们总是穿不舒适的鞋子！

questions.prompt: What's wrong with the fashionable shoes?
questions.answer: They are very uncomfortable, but women always wear them.

items.title: like these
items.text: like these 是介词短语作定语，修饰 shoes。意思是"像这样的鞋子"。

items.title: We don't have any.
items.text: any 后面省略了 black shoes。

items.title: ago
items.text: ago 放在表示时间长度的短语的后面，常与表示一般过去时的动词连用。如 a month ago（一个月之前）。

items.title: in fashion
items.text: in fashion, 流行的, 时髦的。

items.title: I'm afraid ...
items.text: I'm afraid ... 我恐怕……（用于委婉地表达否定或歉意）。

lesson.text:
参考译文
女士：像这样的鞋子你们有吗？
售货员：什么尺码的？
女士：5号的。
售货员：什么颜色？
女士：黑的。
售货员：对不起，我们没有。
女士：但是，我姐姐上个月买到了这样的一双。
售货员：她是在这儿买的吗？
女士：不。她是在美国买的。
售货员：一个月前我们有这样的鞋，但是现在没有了。
女士：您能为我找一双吗？
售货员：恐怕不行。这鞋在去年和前年时兴，而今年已不流行了。
售货员：现在流行的是这种鞋子。
女士：这种鞋子看上去很不舒服。
售货员：的确很不舒服。可是女人们总是穿不舒适的鞋子！

practice.title: B Vocabulary — un- adjectives
practice.instruction: We make some adjective opposites with the prefix un-, for example, comfortable / uncomfortable, tidy / untidy. Choose the most sensible words and write them in. 部分形容词加上前缀 un- 可以构成反义词。选择最恰当的词填空。
practice.translation: Choose the most sensible adjective (or its un- opposite) for each sentence, following the printed example.
practice.context: Item 1 (interesting / uninteresting → interesting) is a printed example and is not editable. Items 2-6 are taken from the supplied Lesson 75 key (img/key-075-080.jpg).

questions.prompt: It was a very ______ film. I watched it twice. (interesting / uninteresting)
He's a very ______ man. He had three car accidents last year. (lucky / unlucky)
It was a very ______ day. It rained all day. (pleasant / unpleasant)
Those shoes are ______. Everyone's wearing them. (fashionable / unfashionable)
My new shoes are very ______. They hurt my feet. (comfortable / uncomfortable)
Jane cleans her room every day. It's always very ______. (tidy / untidy)

grammar.translation: Rewrite each 'Were there ...?' question and answer as a 'Did it have ...?' question and 'It had ...' answer, following the printed example.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=506
grammar.context: The printed example (Were there any doors? → Did it have any doors? / Yes. There was one door. → Yes. It had one door.) is not editable. The remaining 10 items are taken from the supplied Lesson 75 grammar key (PDF viewer page 506).

questions.prompt: Were there any doors? / Yes. There was one door.
questions.answer:
Did it have any doors?
Yes. It had one door.

questions.prompt: Were there any windows? / Yes. There were two windows.
questions.answer:
Did it have any windows?
Yes. It had two windows.

questions.prompt: What else were there in the living room?
questions.answer: What else did the living room have?

questions.prompt: Were there any bookshelves? / Yes. There was one bookshelf.
questions.answer:
Did it have any bookshelves?
Yes. It had one bookshelf.

questions.prompt: What about the furniture? Were there any lamps? / Yes. There were two lamps.
questions.answer:
Did it have any lamps?
Yes. It had two lamps.

questions.prompt: Were there any chairs in the room? / Yes. There were four chairs.
questions.answer:
Did the room have any chairs?
Yes. It had four chairs.

questions.prompt: What else were there in the room?
questions.answer: What else did the room have?

questions.prompt: Were there any tables? / Yes. There was one table.
questions.answer:
Did it have any tables?
Yes. It had one table.
